stemMd: Which statement best reflects the constitutional meaning of popular sovereignty in Italy?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Private firms exercise all public sovereignty.

options.label: C
options.textMd: Sovereignty belongs permanently to one political party.

options.label: D
options.textMd: Sovereignty belongs to the people and is exercised within constitutional forms and limits.

options.label: E
options.textMd: Any majority can disregard the Constitution.

explanationMd: Article 1 places sovereignty in the people while specifying constitutional forms and limits. Democratic authority therefore operates through institutions and constitutional rules. It is not an unrestricted power of any temporary majority.

distractorRationale.a: Economic power is not constitutional sovereignty.
distractorRationale.c: The Constitution does not grant one party permanent power.
